summary: FOMC held benchmark rate at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (third consecutive hold). Most dissents since October 1992 (4 total). Market pricing zero rate changes in 2026, one 25bps cut in December 2027. Inflation elevated partly due to global energy prices from Middle East tensions.
